question: Who among the following was appointed as the Union Minister of Women and Child Development in June 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Annpurna Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annpurna Devi** was appointed as the **Union Minister of Women and Child Development** in **June 2024**.
 
• She is a prominent political leader from **Jharkhand**, representing the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• She has been actively involved in policy-making and implementation related to the **welfare and development** of women and children.
 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development focuses on **child nutrition, women empowerment, protection of children, and childcare services.**
 
• Her leadership in the ministry is expected to address key issues such as **gender equality, child rights, and nutrition programs.**
 
• Annpurna Devi has a strong track record in promoting **educational reforms and social welfare initiatives** in her previous roles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman**__

 __
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman** is the current **Union Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs** in India.
 
• She is the first full-time woman Finance Minister of India.
 
• She has played a crucial role in implementing **economic policies, taxation reforms, and budgetary allocations** in India.
 
• Her leadership has been instrumental in the execution of programs like **Atmanirbhar Bharat** and other fiscal measures during the pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Anupriya Patel**__
 __
 
• **Anupriya Patel** is a Member of Parliament and a leader of the **Apna Dal (Sonelal)**, an ally of BJP.
 
• She has previously served as the **Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare** in India.
 
• Anupriya Patel's contributions have been focused on **healthcare policies, rural health initiatives, and family welfare programs.**
 
 
 
• **Raksha Nikhil Khadse**__
 
 
• **Raksha Nikhil Khadse** is a politician from Maharashtra and a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party.
 
• She has served as a Member of Parliament, focusing on issues related to **agriculture, rural development, and women's rights.**
 
• Her contributions have been significant in addressing **local governance and rural challenges.**
